name: Resupplying the Excavation
summary: In Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm sends you after the slow powder wagon bound for Ironband's Excavation Site. The dwarves haul blastpowder south along the Loch's shore.

sections.title: A Heavy Cargo along the Shore
sections.body: Ironband's Excavation Site in southern Loch Modan needs blastpowder to break through hard rock. After the powder reaches Thelsamar, quartermaster Jern Hornhelm sends Huldar, Miran, and Saean south with heavy barrels. The cargo slows their pack team along the lakeside road, giving travelers in Thelsamar time to catch up and help along the way.

sections.title: Treachery in the Shadows
sections.body: Huldar's wagon has been ambushed on the southern road. Dark Iron dwarves attacked to sabotage the Bronzebeard expedition's archaeological work. Saean, who had worked beside Huldar for nearly a year, helped arrange the ambush as a Dark Iron sympathizer.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Resupplying the Excavation?
aliases: where to start resupplying the excavation
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm sends you from Thelsamar after you bring him the blastpowder. He asks you to follow the road south along the Loch and catch up with the supply team.

faq.q: Where can Huldar and the wagon be found?
aliases: where is the wagon loch modan
faq.answer: Huldar and the wagon are south of Thelsamar, along the road that follows the Loch's western and southern shores toward Ironband's Excavation Site.

faq.q: Why is blastpowder being sent to Ironband?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband and his team dig for ancient relics at the southern excavation site. They need blastpowder to break heavy stone and blast through underground layers.
Jern expects Huldar's team to be on the usual road south of Thelsamar, following the Loch. You learn who attacked the wagon when you reach Huldar.

faq.q: What role did Saean play in the attack?
faq.answer: Saean travels with Huldar and Miran to carry the heavy blastpowder barrels. You learn his part in the attack when you catch up with the team.

faq.q: What quest comes next after finding Huldar?
aliases: next quest after resupplying the excavation
faq.answer: Speaking with Huldar completes this part of the journey. His account of the shipment points you toward what comes next.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you help keep Ironband's work supplied by protecting the blastpowder shipment on Loch Modan's dangerous roads.
You know the danger of moving volatile blasting powder over rough ground. The shipment is vital to the excavators in the south.
